title: Black Lagoon Omake
native: ブラック・ラグーン オマケ
synopsis: Special omake episodes from the Blu-Ray releases, showing the heroines and foes in funny, uncommon situations.
search_text: black lagoon omake フ ラック ラク ーン オマケ special finished

episodes.title: Highschool Life
episodes.synopsis: The characters of Black Lagoon become high school students.

episodes.title: The Magical Girl
episodes.synopsis: Revy becomes a magical girl, and helps Rock against a gang of "Russian highschool delinquents" led by Balalaika.

episodes.title: The Melancholy of Balalaika
episodes.synopsis: Balalaika has trouble dealing with her two children, Hansel and Gretel, who frequently cause trouble at school, such as making pipe bombs and "playing doctor" with their classmate Garcia which traumatizes him. Her husband, Mr. Chang, is reluctant to do anything.

episodes.title: Boys and Girls
episodes.synopsis: The characters of Black Lagoon switch gender roles.

episodes.title: Summer Evening Spooky Story Contest
episodes.synopsis: The characters of Black Lagoon share horror stories.

episodes.title: Viva! Youth!
episodes.synopsis: The characters of Black Lagoon become middle school students.

episodes.title: Go for it! Manzai Grand Prix!
episodes.synopsis: Yukio announces that she wishes to perform Manzai (Japanese stand-up comedy) during the school cultural festival with Maki. While rehearsing, Yukio's Yakuza subordinates demonstrate a Manzai act, which ends in a bloodfest.
